items.title: Exact observability of abstract plate evolutions from weak Schrodinger observability and eigenvector unique continuation
core_obligations: Given the compact-resolvent spectral theorem, admissible first-order observation, Fourier decay for a smooth time cutoff and compactness/Riesz facts, separate observability of e^(itA) and e^(-itA) does not directly control their superposed plate output because of cancellation. The author uses the positive/negative-frequency splitting and a cutoff supported in the larger time interval to turn the interaction into a compact lower-order remainder, exploiting the explicit summability assumption on eigenvalues. Difference quotients then regularize the invisible space, prove its invariance and finite dimension, and the author eigenvector-UCP assumption eliminates it, upgrading weak to exact observability for both CAz and Czdot. Count complete Proposition4.8 with Propositions4.6/4.7 andallsetups as one H2 transfer result,not a new count for each intermediate estimate or the final short compactness argument. The nonlinear analytic-reconstruction core isalreadyqualified2536 andisnotrecounted.
